description: Summary figure: presence/absence of downstream HepGP-pathway steps in G. kaustophilus, and conserved synteny of pcrB and yvoF loci
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.patches as mpatches

hits = pd.concat([pd.read_csv(f) for f in ["hits_part1.csv","hits_part2.csv","hits_part3.csv","hits_part4.csv"]])
best = hits.sort_values("bits",ascending=False).groupby("query",as_index=False).first()
order = ["PcrB_Bsu HepGP synthase (positive control)",
         "YvoF_Bsu HepG-P O-acetyltransferase",
         "YpjA/LhaT_Bsu lipoprotein N-acetyltransferase",
         "Maa_Ecoli maltose O-acetyltransferase",
         "GGR_Afu digeranylgeranylglycerophospholipid reductase (archaeal)",
         "AraM/EgsA_Bsu G1P dehydrogenase",
         "EgsA_Mth archaeal G1P dehydrogenase",
         "DGGGPS_Sso digeranylgeranylglyceryl-P synthase (UbiA fam)",
         "CarS_Mth CDP-archaeol synthase"]
short = {order[0]:"PcrB (B. subtilis)\n[control]", order[1]:"YvoF\nHepG acetyltransferase",
         order[2]:"LhaT / YpjA\nlipoprotein N-acetyltransf.", order[3]:"Maa\nmaltose O-acetyltransf.",
         order[4]:"GGR (archaeal)\nprenyl reductase", order[5]:"AraM / EgsA\nG1P dehydrogenase (Bsu)",
         order[6]:"EgsA (archaeal)\nG1P dehydrogenase", order[7]:"DGGGPS (archaeal)\n2nd prenyl transfer",
         order[8]:"CarS (archaeal)\nCDP-archaeol synthase"}
b = best.set_index("query").loc[order].reset_index()
calls = ["ortholog","ortholog","ortholog","ortholog","no ortholog","absent","absent","absent","absent"]
colors = {"ortholog":"#2f6f9f","no ortholog":"#b0902f","absent":"#9f3f3f"}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(15.5,6.4), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.05,1]})
ax=axes[0]
y=np.arange(len(b))[::-1]
ax.barh(y, b.bits, color=[colors[c] for c in calls], height=0.62)
for yy,(bi,hit,gene,c) in zip(y, zip(b.bits,b.hit,b.gene,calls)):
    lab = f"{gene} ({hit})" if c in ("ortholog",) else (f"best hit {gene}" if c=="no ortholog" else "no hit above noise")
    ax.text(bi+6, yy, f"{bi:.0f} bits  |  {lab}", va="center", fontsize=8.6)
ax.axvspan(0,40,color="0.88",zorder=0)
ax.text(42,len(b)-0.4,"noise / superfamily band (<40 bits)",fontsize=8,color="0.35")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([short[q] for q in b["query"]], fontsize=8.8)
ax.set_xlabel("best ungapped BLOSUM62 HSP score vs G. kaustophilus HTA426 proteome (bits)")
ax.set_xlim(0,400)
ax.set_title("A. Which steps downstream of PcrB are encoded in G. kaustophilus HTA426?\n3516 proteins searched, Karlin-Altschul E-values", fontsize=10.5, loc="left")
ax.legend(handles=[mpatches.Patch(color=colors[k],label=l) for k,l in
                   [("ortholog","clear ortholog present"),("no ortholog","superfamily-level only"),("absent","no homolog detected")]],
          loc="lower right", fontsize=8.5, frameon=False)

# Panel B: synteny
ax=axes[1]; ax.axis("off")
def draw(trackY, genes, title):
    ax.text(0.0, trackY+0.52, title, fontsize=9.2, fontweight="bold")
    n=len(genes); w=1.0/n
    for i,(name,col) in enumerate(genes):
        x=i*w
        ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyArrow(x+0.004, trackY, w-0.018, 0, width=0.17,
                     head_width=0.17, head_length=0.012, length_includes_head=True,
                     color=col, linewidth=0))
        ax.text(x+w/2, trackY-0.30, name, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=7.4, rotation=0)
C={"pcrB":"#2f6f9f","dna":"#8a8a8a","lipo":"#4c9a6a","other":"#cfcfcf","acet":"#c47a1a","phos":"#7b5aa6","lgt":"#4c9a6a"}
g1=[("yerA\nade deaminase",C["dna"]),("yerB\nlipoprotein",C["lipo"]),("yerC",C["other"]),("yerD",C["other"]),
    ("pcrB\nHepGP synthase",C["pcrB"]),("pcrA\nhelicase",C["dna"]),("ligA\nDNA ligase",C["dna"]),("yerH\nlipoprotein",C["lipo"])]
g2=[("GK0271\nade deaminase",C["dna"]),("GK0272",C["lipo"]),("GK0273",C["other"]),("—",C["other"]),
    ("GK0274 pcrB\nHepGP synthase",C["pcrB"]),("GK0275\nhelicase",C["dna"]),("GK0276\nDNA ligase",C["dna"]),("GK0277",C["lipo"])]
g3=[("yvoF\nacetyltransferase",C["acet"]),("ppaX/hprP\nHAD phosphatase",C["phos"]),("yvoD",C["other"]),
    ("lgt\nprolipoprot. DAG transf.",C["lgt"]),("hprK",C["other"])]
g4=[("GK3078\nacetyltransferase",C["acet"]),("GK3079\nHAD phosphatase",C["phos"]),("GK3080",C["other"]),
    ("GK3081 lgt\nprolipoprot. DAG transf.",C["lgt"]),("GK3082 hprK",C["other"])]
draw(3.6,g1,"B. subtilis 168   pcrB locus"); draw(2.6,g2,"G. kaustophilus HTA426   pcrB locus")
draw(1.1,g3,"B. subtilis 168   yvoF locus"); draw(0.1,g4,"G. kaustophilus HTA426   yvoF locus")
ax.set_xlim(-0.02,1.02); ax.set_ylim(-0.6,4.5)
ax.set_title("B. Conserved gene order: pcrB sits in a DNA-repair operon,\nthe YvoF acetyltransferase sits beside a HAD phosphatase and lgt", fontsize=10.5, loc="left")
ax.text(0.0,-0.55,"synteny invariant in 13/13 Bacillales genomes carrying pcrB (KEGG): d(pcrB,pcrA)=1, d(pcrB,ligA)=2, d(yvoF,lgt)<=3",
        fontsize=8, color="0.3")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
b.to_csv("best_hits_summary.csv",index=False)
print(b[["query","hit","gene","bits","Evalue"]].to_string(index=False))
